SabrParameters.description: Parameters of a SABR backbone, with an optional signed rate displacement.

beta.description: CEV exponent in the closed interval `[0, 1]`.

nu.description: Volatility of volatility, nonnegative; zero is the deterministic-volatility limit.

rho.description: Forward-volatility correlation in the open interval `(-1, 1)`.

shift.description: Optional finite displacement applied to forward and strike.

description: Calibrated SABR parameters and deterministic solver diagnostics.

max_relative_quote_error.description: Largest absolute quote error divided by its positive market quote.

parameters_at_bounds.description: Parameter names whose calibrated values landed on configured bounds.

quote_errors.description:
Signed model-minus-market errors, in the original quote units: decimal
absolute rate volatility for normal quotes, relative decimals for Black.

residual_evaluations.description:
Actual objective residual invocations across all deterministic starts,
including attempts rejected by the solver or final quote-fit checks.

total_iterations.description: Total iterations consumed across all attempted starts.

winning_iterations.description: Iterations consumed by the selected start.

winning_start.description: Initial alpha, nu, and rho values for the selected start.

title: SabrCalibrationOutcome
